### Final Year Project: BLESmart — Indoor BLE Localisation & Occupancy Detection
[Final Year Project]{.tag} [IoT & ESP32]{.tag} [Machine Learning]{.tag} [Node-RED & MQTT]{.tag} [InfluxDB & Grafana]{.tag} [Python]{.tag}

Engineered a low-cost edge-computing pipeline using an ESP32-C6 and BLE beacons to perform zone- and room-level spatial classification (WKNN & Random Forest) and privacy-preserving classroom occupancy estimation (Multiple Linear Regression) via MQTT, Node-RED, InfluxDB, and Grafana.
